meta.title: 裙子鞋袜万能穿搭技巧

scenes.title_en: Skirt Length Sets the Shoe's Presence
scenes.context: 裙子越短，露肤越多，鞋的视觉存在感越强，要选鞋面多、量感足的款式；裙子越长，腿部被包裹，鞋子退居轻量。
sentences: The shorter the skirt, the more shoe you show.
The longer the skirt, the less shoe you show.
paraphrase: Let the shoes carry more visual weight.
Keep the shoes quiet and light.
scenes.speak: The shorter the skirt, the more shoe you show. The longer the skirt, the less shoe you show.

scenes.context: 紧身裙配细跟延续利落线条；轻飘裙配重体鞋压住重心；花哨裙配简洁鞋做繁简互衬。三条都是互补逻辑。
sentences: The tighter the skirt, the slimmer the heel.
The lighter the skirt, the chunkier the shoe.
裙子越花哨，鞋子越简洁。
The busier the skirt, the simpler the shoes.
paraphrase: Match sleek with sleek, floaty with grounded.
Let the skirt be the statement, shoes the support.
scenes.speak: The tighter the skirt, the slimmer the heel. The lighter the skirt, the chunkier the shoe. The busier the skirt, the simpler the shoes.

scenes.title_cn: 四种裙型的具体配鞋方案
scenes.title_en: Four Skirt Types, Four Shoe Pairings
scenes.context: 把口诀落地成四组标准搭配：长裙配平底鞋、短裙配长靴、开叉裙配高跟鞋、碎花裙配小白鞋。
sentences: Pair a maxi skirt with flats.
Pair a mini skirt with tall boots.
Pair a slit skirt with heels.
Pair a floral skirt with white sneakers.
scenes.speak: Pair a maxi skirt with flats. Pair a mini skirt with tall boots. Pair a slit skirt with heels. Pair a floral skirt with white sneakers.

practice.a: The shorter the skirt, the more shoe you show.
The tighter the skirt, the slimmer the heel.
Pair a floral skirt with white sneakers.
Pair a slit skirt with heels.

pitfalls: Wear the shoes you like regardless of the skirt.
Let the skirt dictate the shoes.
Skirt length, fit, fabric weight and pattern each set what shoe works.
Always pair a short skirt with heels.
Tall boots also work with mini skirts.
Boot shafts add lower-body volume, so the boots balance the bare legs.
Pair a floral skirt with statement shoes too.
Keep the shoes simple with a busy skirt.
Two bold pieces compete; one must take a back seat.
shifts: 按「喜欢哪双穿哪双」选鞋，常与裙子不搭
先看裙子四维（长度/松紧/材质/花色）再定鞋
